scripts.build: npm run build -w spacetime && npm run build -w seeders && npm run build -w web
scripts.bindings: spacetime generate --lang typescript -p spacetime -o web/src/module_bindings -y && spacetime generate --lang typescript -p spacetime -o seeders/src/module_bindings -y && spacetime generate --lang typescript -p spacetime -o client/src/module_bindings -y
scripts.test: npm run test -w spacetime && npm run test -w seeders && npm run test -w gate
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w spacetime && npm run typecheck -w seeders && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w gate
